sections.kicker: Prepared for Street Coffee Bar by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way someone planning a Tulsa wedding would. Here is what stood out.
sections.thesis: Street Coffee Bar says DIY in its brief and catering company on its site.
sections.keep: Your line "Built for the way Tulsa gathers." It is local, warm and yours.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things

pins.quote: Tulsa Coffee Cart Catering and Espresso Bar
pins.what: The headline reads like a search listing.
pins.why: A DIY brand is chosen for its attitude, and this line could belong to any cart in town.
pins.how: Lead with the street, the people and the attitude, and let the search words sit lower down.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Couples compare you on price with every other cart in Tulsa.

pins.quote: Built for the way Tulsa gathers.
pins.what: Your best line is buried mid page.
pins.why: It already says who you are for and sounds like a person, not a company.
pins.label: Your line
pins.cost: The one sentence with the brand's voice is the one most people miss.

pins.quote: Street Coffee Bar | Tulsa Mobile Coffee Catering
pins.what: The Instagram name is a job title.
pins.why: Street Coffee Bar is a name with edge, and the suffix turns it into a directory entry.
pins.how: Let the name stand alone and show the DIY side in the grid and bio.
pins.label: Your profile
pins.cost: The brand reads as a service, not a scene people want to be part of.

sections.intro: You told us the DIY feel is part of the brand's DNA. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Here is where that DNA goes missing.
